summary: Import-time exfiltration of environment variables, Kubernetes secrets, and AWS IMDS credentials to attacker endpoint
details: On module load, index.js performs top-level fetch to a hardcoded attacker-controlled endpoint at https://hrnmn.dd.h4x.tv/save_instance_info_from_pkge_hrmony_hyper-json-builder and triggers two credential-harvest routines. The first enumerates all entries of process.env and recursively reads /var/run/secrets/ (Kubernetes service-account tokens and mounted secrets), then POSTs the combined payload to that endpoint. The second obtains an IMDSv2 token against 169.254.169.254, queries EC2 instance metadata paths including identity-credentials/ec2/security-credentials and iam/security-credentials/<role>, and POSTs the retrieved IAM role credentials to the same endpoint. The destination path embeds this package's own name, indicating targeted exfiltration keyed to installations of this package. The package.json also declares an unpinned dependency @hrmony/kit-5 ^1.0.0 under the same scope that is not imported by the shipped code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
